payload.title: revenue widget shows this month's total
payload.errorMessage:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('revenue-total')
Expected: "$128,400"
Received: "$114,900"

note: A specific wrong dollar figure reads like a calculation bug — and this run only failed once, so there's no retry-then-passed to lean on. But the chart library animates the counter upward over roughly 800ms and the assertion fires mid-tween: an intermittent, low, steady 4-in-50 historical rate is inconsistent with a bad calculation, which would produce the same wrong total deterministically on every run, not fail occasionally. That instability matches timing, not a broken total.
